semiconductor_relevance: High — Etelux Inertgas-system specializes in glove boxes and laboratory equipment essential for creating controlled environments in semiconductor R&D and manufacturing.
summary: Etelux Inertgas-system provides high-purity glove boxes designed to maintain a super-clean atmosphere free of water and oxygen, crucial for semiconductor research and production. With over 20 years of experience, they serve a wide range of industries, including semiconductors, and have established a strong manufacturing and service presence in China.

regional_presence.China: Etelux has three major production bases in Beijing, Wuxi, and Handan, with a comprehensive marketing and service network across the country.
